sources.evidence: The key is not simply buying the largest battery. It is knowing which devices matter most , how many watts they use, and how heater cycling changes real runtime.

sources.evidence: 36 hours and 13 minutes is the number that matters . It is the measured runtime of this particular aquarium, pump and power station combination under real operating conditions.

why: No major reviewer or authority appears. Two Generac hits are dead, two are pet retailers' care articles, two are power-station brand blogs, and the rest are generic 'prioritise oxygen, shed the heater' guides with no model, capacity or price. The only real data is reefs.com's single Bluetti Elite 100 V2 test on a reef tank without the heater, which is a neighbouring question. A page that sizes the 24-hour load for this exact tank and names priced units would be the only direct answer in the set.
